name: Subactor Credential Harvest
summary: Exact, fail-closed URI Process for grant-gated credential harvest into the private Vault.
description: Calls only the deployment-controlled LLM Account Hub harvest command and never accepts a target URL or credential value. Requires a caller-supplied live credential.harvest grant already issued by Subactor Control; the connector never issues or revokes authority. The response carries references only (vault entry id, source kind, counts), never a secret value.
